summary: A person gave a campaign a standing approval for one category of reply, or replaced the one in force, so drafted replies it covers go without a decision each time.

standing.description: A standing approval as it was set.

category.description: The category of reply the standing approval covers.

operations.description: The operations it releases, in ordinal order.

expires_at.description: When it stops releasing work; null where it does not expire.

max_releases.description: How many releases it makes before it stops; null where it has no ceiling.

key.description: The category of reply, which the campaign's newest line for it decides.

old.description: The standing approval this one replaced; null where none was in force.
